Fixture-level gate theorems (cell inequalities/equalities over the Q4 model-layer fixture) cannot be pinned in the Lean Challenge Statements block: lean-challenge-snapshot.sh forces every declaration body, fixture defs included, to sorry, so such statements cannot type-check standalone. The research's short-idle bound prose (2^k - 2) counts regions from a different base than iter_doubling's indexing; the plan instructs the implementer to compute the fixture bound by hand before writing the pair rather than carry the figure.

Scope hypothesis deviation noted: grep -c '^theorem\|^def' on the prototype gives 32, not the plan's 23 (the 23 counted headline/named declarations; nothing was dropped).

Phase 2: the 4-cycle fixture compiled after three repair passes (simp loop on eq_comm in truth_l4; Prod.ext inside rw; fun h => by cases h as a refine-tuple component). step4_card = 16 by decide confirms the scope hypothesis. The generic twoRay/liftAdm/gPast4/region4 constructors mean Phases 3-7 glue explicit rays with no new IsSlicedStepPath proofs.

Phase 3: gates 1 and 2 compiled as SEPARATION on Q4 (gate1_cell_ne every B; gate2_cell_ne every c, n) on the second pass; the only repair was restating three Duration-order obligations over Z for omega. Non-vacuity witnesses were stated and compiled before both inequalities.

Phase 4: gate 9 separation half compiled as SEPARATION (gate9_sep_cell_ne, not-4-divides-m the only hypothesis on m). The obstruction does not need 1 <= n (window at n = 0 is {0,1}); the target signature was kept verbatim with the linter silenced for that declaration and the reason recorded in the docstring and header. Two repairs: a no-op simp, and the untl witness needing an explicit (s : Z) binder ascription for omega.

Phase 5: the short-idle gate compiled as SEPARATION at k = 1 (short_idle_cell_ne every P >= 1) with the bound computed first (region_doubling at L = 0, j = 1 gives 2; growRay 0 3 = (true, 2, 2) by decide), the shape companion short_idle_shape_collides (every T <= 2, every modulus dividing the shift) and their conjunction short_idle_threshold_refuted. The obstruction needs only the two pins and Drift; the idle-forever conjunct is not load-bearing at k = 1. Family stretch not compiled (time box); carried by iter_doubling at the arithmetic level, recorded in the plan's own words.

The plan's target statement for short_idle_shape_collides carried a duplicated binder (hT : T <= 2) (hT' : T <= 2) and no divisibility clause, while its prose names 'every modulus P' = P + 1 dividing P'. Implemented with (hP : (P' + 1) | P) in place of the duplicate; the literal statement without it is false for P >= 2 at modulus P + 1. Recorded here and in the summary rather than escalated as a blocker.

Phase 6 (decision gate): gate 9 collision half compiled as an EQUALITY of cells (gate9_col_cell_eq, every n >= 2) on the third pass; no contingency (modulus 8) needed. The per-member truth lemmas were done by a structural induction over the closure (agree9: atoms and the three untl members by simp on the raw subformula list, imp by plusClosure_imp_left/right, box/snce/stab refuted by simp) rather than a 16-way rcases, which avoids depending on simp's disjunct ordering. datum_achievable is a two-sided set equality as the plan requires.

dispatch_seq 3 stalled on an API credit exhaustion mid-Phase-7; the resumed instance found the uncommitted fragment carrying 8 errors (not the 1 reported), all in absorber4, caused by rw leaving tuple projections unreduced in the Rlad conjuncts. Fixed by replacing the simp only chains with four past7 evaluation lemmas plus dsimp only after each rewrite group.

Both decision gates compiled COLLISION: gate9_col_cell_eq (phase 6) and gap_shift_cell_eq (phase 7), each an EQUALITY of cellAt values. Neither hazard is a seventh mechanism, so the ladder route stays open and no contingency branch was taken.
